name: @knowget/alumni
description: Alumni, Community & Relationship Platform (P2-D24) — the institution's alumni-network and community system of record: the alumni-profile network membership built on the alumnus lifecycle stage that Student Lifecycle (P2-D03) owns, the regional/interest chapters and their memberships, the reunion and networking events and their registrations, the mentorship connections between alumni, and the immutable giving/contribution record. A pure engagement engine derives each alumnus's engagement score and level from their activity; a pure participation engine derives event fill and attendance against capacity. The alumnus/student record belongs to Student Lifecycle (P2-D03); money (gift amounts) is out of scope (Finance P2-D14) and domain events carry no money and no PII.
